A tiny max_image_size does not crash conversion even when the image exceeds the limit

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["extractImages" => true, "maxImageSize" => 10]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>Tiny limit: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", $options);
var_dump($result);
```
